1: A worker says he can only worship in the mosque. Volume 7 stresses that worship is everywhere, in any position of the body. Which ayat is the basis for this view?
2: Ahmad often says God's name but never reflects on creation. According to Volume 7, his dhikr is only half done, because dhikr is two: saying God's name and thinking about God's creation. Which ayat is the basis?
3: A researcher studies nature while remembering God, to find the furqan that keeps hardship away and brings prosperity. Which ayat fits best according to Volume 7?
4: A student has no ambition at all. Volume 7 says it all starts with the question of desire, and with sparking a desire for a better life in this world. Which ayat is the basis?
5: Some say that wanting a better life in this world is a sign of weak faith. Volume 7 stresses that wanting the life of this world is allowed, and its reward is given in full without loss. Which ayat?
6: An entrepreneur wants to develop himself with wealth, success and progress. Volume 7 calls this desiring to develop oneself with the splendors of the world. Which ayat?
7: You worry that your efforts in this world will go to waste. Volume 7 says those who desire the world will not suffer loss; their work is rewarded in full. Which ayat gives this assurance?
8: Volume 7 tells us to see the world and its splendors as an investment for life; only then does the world become useful. Which ayat, on wanting the life of this world, is the basis?
9: A young man wants to raise the rank of his life. Volume 7 names two paths Allah promises: faith and knowledge. Which ayat mentions both?
10: A professor is very clever but holds no faith. According to Volume 7, knowledge alone is not enough; rank is also raised through faith. Which ayat?
11: A very devout person refuses to seek knowledge. Volume 7 reminds us that rank is raised through faith, and also through knowledge. Which ayat?
12: A lecturer feels he is the cleverest person in everything. Volume 7 reminds us that superior knowledge belongs to no single person, and expertise lies in many fields. Which ayat?
13: A mother lets her child go to live far away and hands his care to God. Volume 7 says this truth must be tested; only then is God felt to be near. Which ayat?
14: According to Volume 7, which ayat teaches belief in the One God, who holds two levels of rising for His servants: rising in this world and rising in the hereafter?
15: A father prays that his child prospers in life, when returning to meet God, and when raised again. Which ayat names these three times?
16: A friend offers help, but after accepting it you feel pressured and restless. Volume 7 says that if happiness and calm are lost, it is not help. Which ayat?
17: Which ayat, according to Volume 7, explains Allah's help as something that comes to bring happiness, not just to solve a problem?
18: A patient recovers and his heart is calm again. Volume 7 says that calm heart is itself a sign of Allah's help. Which ayat?
19: A Volume 7 keyword: sustenance grows along its path. Which ayat mentions kharaja, the way out that makes sustenance from God grow?
20: Before starting a business negotiation, you pray that it is easy to enter and easy to exit. Which ayat?
21: Volume 7 says work succeeds when help from the authorities comes easily. The prayer in which ayat asks for a supporting authority?
22: An engineer is technically skilled but neglects his bond with God. Volume 7 says inspiration is two: coarse inspiration for worldly matters and the inspiration of taqwa for a godly life. Which ayat?
23: Which ayat, according to Volume 7, links a person's gain or loss to whether the soul is purified, after people are given two kinds of inspiration?
24: Volume 7 links this ayat to electrons knocked out of an atom's orbit, changing the structure and function of water until it becomes a cure. Which ayat?
25: A student watches night and day take turns, and understands that the earth turns while the sun stays put. Volume 7 calls this the far-sighted attitude of ulul albab. Which ayat?
26: A company wants to build excellent leaders: high desire, far-sighted, sincere and keen to purify themselves. Volume 7 takes three prophets as the example. Which ayat?
27: Volume 7 says God chose the trait of masculinity: able to bring change, guided by revelation and ready to be a point of reference. Which ayat is about the chosen messengers?
28: You do not understand something. Volume 7 says to build the habit of asking and to find an expert, because masculinity means knowing one's own ignorance. Which ayat?
29: Volume 7 explains kharaja as sustenance that comes through effort, and says the wage from God is better than hoping for a wage from people. Which ayat?
30: A young man is comfortable living on other people's help. Volume 7 corrects him: charity received is not the masculinity of sustenance; income from effort is the fruit of kharaja. Which ayat?
31: A farmer works as hard as he can, then sustenance comes from a source he never expected. Volume 7 says: strive while you are able, and when your strength runs out, God does the work. Which ayat?
32: A project manager finishes the work stage by stage. Volume 7 reminds us that God Himself created in six stages, so put your trust in Him after each task. Which ayat?
33: Volume 7 says a smart person knows his God is close and his prayer is answered, on condition that he believes. Which ayat?
34: Volume 7 says everything has its path: the path of the norms of creation and the path of human desire, and our task is to find the path to achievement. Which ayat?
35: Two siblings choose very different careers. Volume 7 says effort takes many forms and ways, as long as the opportunity and the effort are equal and matched. Which ayat?
36: Volume 7 says hidden furqan comes in two forms: what God brings out as the norm of creation, and what people bring out for people. Which ayat mentions hidden delights as the reward for effort?
37: A scientist spends years studying a tiny insect. Volume 7 says God shows amthal (things to observe) as a source of furqan, and believing in them makes a nation advance. Which ayat?
38: A traveller feels alone in a foreign land. Volume 7 says wherever a person is, there is his God, and feeling God close is worship. Which ayat?
39: Volume 7 uses the image of iron and a machete: where the iron is, there the machete is, never apart. Which ayat?
40: Volume 7 likens life to water that can be put to use and brings the face of the earth to life, that is, develops society and the nation. Which ayat?
41: A young leader who did much good becomes involved in evil, and his good work is lost. Volume 7 likens this to the wind that dries up the plants. Which ayat?
42: Someone asks for sustenance by calling on the name of God linked to sustenance. Volume 7 says every prayer is made in the name of God that relates to what is being asked for. Which ayat?

48: After an entrepreneur's business succeeds, many people come to copy his ways. Volume 7 says the colour of success shows, and people come because the person has become an example. Which ayat?

50: Volume 7 says personal achievement is marked by ease, a rank many people see as high, and a bright, clear face. Which ayat?
51: Volume 7 says those already living in ease are always competing, and their ease is shown through branded goods. Which ayat?
52: A young man sleeps a lot and wraps himself in weakness. Volume 7 tells him to get up with a reminder that wakes him. Which ayat?
53: Volume 7 says there is no such thing as weak or sloppy in life: rise with God's greatness, and dress neatly and smartly. Which ayat?
54: A company makes sure every new model is better and more satisfying to users than the last. Volume 7 says life cannot stand still. Which ayat?
55: Volume 7 says prosperity is God's favour, mercy, rank, abundance and pleasure, the way of life God chose. Which ayat says this most briefly?
56: A grandfather tells his grandchild: do not die before prosperity shows in your life. Volume 7 says passing this on to one's descendants is a duty. Which ayat?
57: Volume 7 says the best pattern of life is the one God chose and set, fitting for people as His servants. Which ayat?
58: Volume 7 warns: a heart locked against interpreting and explaining the Al Quran in detail leaves people acting like apes in the forest. Which ayat?
59: Volume 7 sees the Prophet's complaint as his reaction to followers who glorified him, until their way of 'following the Sunnah' made them abandon the Al Quran. Which ayat?
60: A student spends his time with no direction. Volume 7 says time is the core of life, and without good use, loss follows. Which ayat?
61: Volume 7 lists four things that make people gain: faith, the innovator's attitude, truth and patience. Which ayat names all four?

68: A speaker urges people to give charity, yet he himself is stingy. Volume 7 says God dislikes this trait. Which ayat?
69: An investment offer looks very attractive and many join it. Volume 7 reminds us that many forms of the bad look more beautiful than the good, and only ulul albab can tell them apart. Which ayat?

72: You fail the interview for your dream job, but later get a far better opportunity. Which ayat fits best according to Volume 7?
73: Volume 7 says the green of trees is a sign of fertility and an adornment of a good land. Which ayat?

77: Volume 7 says the worth of serving one's parents is like the worth of serving God, and recalls a mother's hardship in pregnancy and nursing. Which ayat?
78: Volume 7 says the progress of a nation starts with one person among its people who sparks a revolution of progress. Which ayat?
